breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet. The ground truth correctly removed the incorrect Dirichlet condition, leaving only the periodic one. The generated specification also correctly states to 'Apply periodic boundary conditions on the spatial domain,' thus resolving the inconsistency.
